name: Band Seated Chest Press
steps: Sit tall on a chair or the floor with a resistance band wrapped across your upper back and the ends gripped beside your chest.
Set your shoulder blades back and down with elbows angled roughly 45 degrees from your torso.
Press both hands straight forward until your arms are extended in front of your chest.
Bend your elbows slowly to bring your hands back beside your chest under tension.
tips: Position the band smoothly across your shoulder blades well below your neck.
Keep your torso tall and avoid rounding your shoulders forward at full extension.
